name: Helpdesk - 06 Error Capture and Dead Letter (inactive)

parameters.query: INSERT INTO helpdesk.failed_jobs (ticket_id,stage,failure_class,error_code,attempt_count,next_retry_at,terminal,replay_context,idempotency_key) VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid,(SELECT ticket_id FROM helpdesk.tickets WHERE idempotency_key=$8)), $2,$3,$4,0,$5::timestamptz,$6,$7::jsonb,$8) RETURNING failed_job_id,ticket_id,stage,terminal;

INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT t.ticket_id,'workflow_failed','workflow:helpdesk-error-capture',t.correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('failed_job_id',$2::uuid,'stage',$3,'terminal',$4::boolean) FROM helpdesk.tickets t WHERE t.ticket_id=$1::uuid RETURNING event_id;
